channel.title: The Valley Times-News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Valley Times-News (valleytimes-news.com)

item.title: Miss Greater Valley to be crowned next month
item.description: Springwood’s third annual Miss Greater Valley Pageant is scheduled for Saturday, March 21. The pageant is open to all contestants ages three months to 18 years in the Greater Valley Area and surrounding areas.

item.title: Entries accepted for annual youth art show
item.description: Registration is now open for local youth to participate in this year’s “Making My Mark” art and writing show. The show is hosted each year by the Valley Arts Council.

item.title: Kids’ workshop returns to West Point
item.description: The West Point Community Academic Recreational Enrichment Services (C.A.R.E.S) program is returning with another kids’ workshop designed to spark interest in building through hands-on crafts.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Kristy McCormally: Dear Mom, How Do I Host? The RSVP: A Love Letter in Disguise
item.description: Kristy McCormally on why RSVPs aren’t optional, how guests should respond, how hosts can follow up with grace, and the digital tools that simplify planning every gathering.

item.title: Southern Union launches free CDL training program for women to address workforce demand
item.description: Southern Union State Community College’s Technical Education and Workforce Development Division is offering a Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) training program exclusively for women, aimed at removing barriers to workforce entry and meeting the growing demand for truck drivers.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Michael Brooks: Edmund Pettus And Me
item.description: A Selma pastor recalls walking the Edmund Pettus Bridge, stories from Bloody Sunday, and how one former officer’s heart was transformed by God’s grace

item.title: Lanett employee recognized for heroic efforts
item.description: Lanett meter reader Lane Lauderdale is honored after finding a man stuck on his porch in 25-degree weather, calling 911 and, officials say, helping avert a potentially tragic outcome.

item.title: Sweep the Hooch returns
item.description: Chattahoochee Riverkeeper seeks volunteers for its 16th Sweep the Hooch cleanup, with 65 sites from North Georgia to Columbus.

item.title: Springwood basketball program filled with success
item.description: The Springwood varsity basketball teams came within inches of winning state championships this year. The teams may have come up short in their state championship goals, but their seasons still had plenty of accomplishments to be proud of, including career milestones and All-Star selections.
